description: The inventory of models, agents, prompts, MCP servers and credentials, each with an owner, dates and links. The source of truth that every other governance control reads.
An asset whose owner left or never existed. Nobody rotates its keys, answers for it or turns it off.
A key or grant unused for a long period. Probably a forgotten pilot, and an attractive target because nobody notices its use.
Evidence of unsanctioned AI use: unregistered keys, models or agents in gateway logs, AI domains in egress logs, OAuth grants, expenses.
AI bill of materials: the models, datasets, prompts, tools and services a product depends on, listed like a software bill of materials.
A recorded end-of-life state for an asset, with its credentials revoked and its records kept for the audit trail.
